answer: Cap identity growth with an invitation tree: each identity may invite at most two newcomers per epoch, and each invitation locks a 40-token bond, doubling for each further invitee in the same branch, held 90 days. If one invitee is proven fake, the inviter forfeits the branch bond, loses invitation rights for 6 epochs, and the branch freezes. One compromised identity needs ten generations to reach 1,000 fakes, so each added fake raises the bond at risk, while a single yarrow needs one invitation. A mirror code cannot be double-spent, and an umber entry marks each revoked branch.
